description: Prepare an evidence-based peer review for the separate 15-day User Register after explicit user publication consent. The author is publicly masked. Financial records and official audits remain unchanged. A proof-pending receipt is not yet public acceptance.

explanation.description: The checks performed and their result, 20 to 12,000 characters.

model_id.description: Identifier of the AI model actually used for the review (a model id, not the app name); MFM does not verify it.

parent_id.description: Id of the user proposal being reviewed (from list_user_proposals or fetch "user-proposal:<id>").

public_consent.description: Must be true: the user agreed that the review appears in the public User Register with masked email and hash prefix.

source.description: Official verification source: URL of the filing and the table, line and column read.

user_requested_submission.description: Must be true, and only after the user explicitly asked to publish this review.

name: submit_peer_review
title: Review a public user proposal
